EarLY KINDS OF PicruURE WRITING gradually die away. And new cities grow where the old used to be and fresh crowds of people come and live in them. And they too die and leave no sign or trace behind. We call a man old when he is seventy or eighty years of age. But what is seventy or eighty when we think of these thousands of years?
